title: OK Pack
description: A tech-focused Minecraft modpack designed for multiplayer gameplay. Build advanced machines, automate everything, and collaborate or compete with other players.
body:
# OK Pack

A modpack built on Minecraft Java Edition version 1.20.1, that focuses on exploration, technology and multiplayer gameplay.

## World Exploration
Explore a completely overhauled world by mods such as **Biomes O' Planty** and **Terralith**. The visuals of this world are enhanced by **Distant Horizons** and **shaders**.

## Technology
Create complex machines with **Create** and many of its addons. Also take advantage of **Immersive Engineering** and **Immersive Petroleum**.

## Multiplayer Gameplay
Communicate with others via **Simple Voice Chat**, and know what other players are doing with **What Are They Up To (WATUT)**.
